title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_tiques_et_maladies_a_tiques_by_karen_d_mccoy_nathalie_boulanger_191kq (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_tiques_et_maladies_a_tiques_by_karen_d_mccoy_nathalie_boulanger_191kq' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine due to potential persistent control by attackers.
